BiblicalUsage: Naharai is the armourbearer of Joab, named twice in the lists of David's mighty men. In 1 Chronicles 11:39 he stands as Naharai the Berothite, the armourbearer of Joab the son of Zeruiah, and in 2 Samuel 23:37 the same title and the same name appear again.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the armourbearer is the quiet half of the hero's story, because the man who carries the shield never gets the song. Naharai stood beside Joab, and the book remembers him for it.
